draft_en.subject: Industrial switches and converters under the digicomm label for OT networks - a second ODM source
draft_en.body:
Hello digicomm team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 23 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial switches and media converters sold under the digicomm label for OT networks (ONV-built today), a second ODM source in your housing from small lots, -40 to 75 C, redundant DC input, CE/RoHS: DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed, Marvell-based - model STI-288GPM - $85.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); L2+ with ring redundancy - STI-288DGGPM - $137.5; Gigabit media converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP - STI-110GE - $26.5. SFPs stay with your current source.

One question: which model do your utility customers reorder most - that is the one worth a side-by-side with the ONV unit?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
